channel.title: Replicate incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Replicate's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: A100 hardware partial outage [resolved]
item.description: We've been below capacity for A100 hardware for the past 30 minutes and all queues have been drained. Thanks for your patience 💖

item.title: Delayed scaling due to node failure [resolved]
item.description: All affected models have been scaling correctly for more than 30 minutes at this point, and we see no residual prediction queues. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Significant degradation [resolved]
item.description: We have been monitoring for a while and services seem to be back. Thank you for your patience

item.title: API degraded for A100s [resolved]
item.description: We have restarted the affected component and service should be back to normal. Thank you for your patience

item.title: Degraded scale-out due to failed setups pulling from huggingface [resolved]
item.description: We're looking stable now, and with caching back on. Thanks again for your patience!

item.title: Hitting GPU Capacity for H100s creating large queue times for some models [resolved]
item.description: This issue is resolved

item.title: HuggingFace download issues [resolved]
item.description: We have not seen elevated rates of HuggingFace/model setup errors for a couple hours now, so we believe this incident is cleared

item.title: H100 GPU shortage resulting in high queue times [resolved]
item.description: H100 capacity has returned to normal levels

item.title: High contention on H100 hardware [resolved]
item.description: We are back under max capacity for H100 hardware. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Limited H100 capacity [resolved]
item.description: The H100 capacity is back in good health. Thanks for your patience!

item.title: We're seeing long setup times and high contention for models on some L40S and H200 clusters. [resolved]
item.description: System is back to operating normally

item.title: Degraded performance on flux-2-klein-4b [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved and queue times are back to normal

item.title: Prediction and Training status updates delayed [resolved]
item.description: Message flows are healthy.

item.title: Constrained H100 capacity [resolved]
item.description: H100 hardware contention has resolved. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Constrained capacity for H100 hardware [resolved]
item.description: There is no more contention for H100 hardware. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Degraded A100 hardware [resolved]
item.description: All A100 capacity is back. Thanks for your patience!

item.title: A100 capacity unavailable during storage maintenance [resolved]
item.description: The maintenance is complete and all systems are reporting healthy. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Downstream errors for Black Forest Labs models [resolved]
item.description: Black Forest Labs has resolved the issue.

item.title: Degraded performance on Flux Schnell [resolved]
item.description: Flux Schnell requests are being served normally.

item.title: Model Predictions Stuck at "Starting" [resolved]
item.description: Models are once again operational

item.title: Increased setup failures for T4 models [resolved]
item.description: Model setup failures have dropped to normal levels since 10:40 UTC. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Predictions and training unavailable for multiple models [resolved]
item.description: All infrastructure problems have been resolved and model predictions and training are available again for the relevant hardware types.

item.title: Flux Schnell unavailable [resolved]
item.description: The `black-forest-labs/flux-schnell` model is fully operational now. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Prediction Errors [resolved]
item.description: Incident is resolved.

item.title: High demand for H100 hardware type [resolved]
item.description: We are all clear now. Thank you for your patience!
